# REST API ENDPOINT TEMPLATE

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| **API ID** | API-XXX |
| **Method** | GET / POST / PUT / DELETE |
| **Endpoint** | Actual URL path |
| **Purpose** | What the route does |
| **Authentication** | Required or unauthenticated |
| **Permission** | RBAC permission code required |
| **Request JSON** | Example JSON body |
| **Response JSON** | Example JSON reply |
| **Error Format** | HTTP status codes and error JSON |
| **Source File** | Path and line reference |
| **Database Tables** | Tables read or updated |
